say:1:1411442001:1.text: What do you mean join forces?
say:1:1411442001:1.source_cn: 你们刚刚说的携手并进，是什么意思？

say:3:1411442002:1.text: You know the answer, Baelran. Once upon a time, Kulusta summoned a bomb, but it didn't cause the damage that was expected.
say:3:1411442002:1.source_cn: 你知道答案的，巴赫朗。曾经的库露丝塔，召唤出了炸弹，却...

say:4:1411442003:1.text: Because the bomb was cleaved and shattered before it exploded. Although there was still damage, the impact was much smaller.
say:4:1411442003:1.source_cn: 因为在引爆前，炸弹就被斩碎，尽管仍有损伤，但影响却小得多。

say:5:1411442004:1.text: If an explosion occurs somewhere far from the geo leylines, it might still trigger an earthquake, but the leylines and the volcano won't be affected.
say:5:1411442004:1.source_cn: 如今，在远离地脉的空洞处炸开，或许仍会引发地震，但地脉...

say:6:1411442005:1.text: If history can repeat itself, and the bomb is sliced once again by a holy sword, then its power would be minimized.
say:6:1411442005:1.source_cn: 只要再重演此前的那一幕，以圣剑将之斩碎，那么威力就会被...

say:8:1411442006:1.text: No way! That's not true! It didn't happen that way!
say:8:1411442006:1.source_cn: 不、不行！绝对不行！绝对绝对绝对不行！

say:9:1411442007:1.text: Lady Kulusta's bomb that time could've exploded if she wanted it to!
say:9:1411442007:1.source_cn: 库露丝塔大人的炸弹只要她愿意，就绝对会炸掉！

say:10:1411442008:1.text: Do you know why that bomb was split but didn't explode? It's because...
say:10:1411442008:1.source_cn: 你们不知道为什么那个炸弹被斩碎却没爆炸吗？是因为——

say:11:1411442009:1.text: It's because the sword cleaved into Kulusta herself first.
say:11:1411442009:1.source_cn: 因为那把圣剑，事实上最先斩碎的是正面迎击的库露丝塔本人。

say:12:1411442010:1.text: If a bomb isn't linked to its creator, it won't detonate right away. That gives you a window to shatter it and dull its power.
say:12:1411442010:1.source_cn: 失去主人存在操控的炸弹无法被即时引爆，只能被同样斩碎，...

say:13:1411442011:1.text: Yes, but you cannot harm Lady Kulu! No way!
say:13:1411442011:1.source_cn: 就是这样！不行，绝对不行！你们不能伤害库露露大人！

say:15:1411442012:1.text: Enough, Boomboom! Whoever's at fault needs to take responsibility!
say:15:1411442012:1.source_cn: 够了！阿爆，一人做事一人当！

say:16:1411442013:1.text: I caused this mess, so it should be me who gets cut in half!
say:16:1411442013:1.source_cn: 我已经闯了这么大的祸了，就算被砍碎不也合情合理吗！

say:17:1411442014:1.text: I can't hold on anymore. Hey, old man! Hurry up and do what you need to do!
say:17:1411442014:1.source_cn: 我快撑不住了……喂，老头子！要做什么就快一点！

say:18:1411442015:1.source_cn: ……你比库露丝塔，某种意义上倒还更疯狂一些。
